entry_thesis: Nike reports Q4 FY2026 earnings June 30 AMC (5 days out). Consensus EPS is $0.11 — materially BELOW Nike's own guidance of ~$0.19 — creating an asymmetric bar where even an in-line-with-guidance print beats consensus by ~70%. Stock is at $41.82 (52-week low, down ~48% from $80.17 ATH), options-implied move (~8.9%) is only modestly above the 8.4% historical average — the market is NOT pricing a positive surprise. BNP Paribas just cut target to $23 (bear capitulation signal). Base case ~65% Nike beats the $0.11 bar; market-implied ~50%.
risk: Nike misses the $0.11 EPS consensus (genuine demand collapse worse than feared) OR guides fiscal 2027 sales decline worse than the current 2-4% range, which would confirm the 'Win Now' turnaround is failing and trigger a re-rating lower toward BNP's $23 target. China revenue deterioration beyond the expected ~20% decline would also break the thesis.
target_return: 12-18% in 1 week (post-earnings repricing if consensus beat + stable fiscal 2027 commentary)
catalyst: Nike Q4 FY2026 earnings, June 30 2026 AMC. Base case: 65% Nike beats the depressed $0.11 EPS consensus (because consensus sits below company's own ~$0.19 guidance) and provides fiscal 2027 commentary that is 'less bad' than feared, triggering a relief rally off 52-week lows. Market-implied probability of positive surprise: ~50%.
